entries.citation: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI)

agentObligations.summary: Prohibited practices: points (a) subliminal techniques, (b) exploiting vulnerabilities, (c) social scoring, (d) offence risk assessment based on profiling, (e) untargeted facial-image scraping, (f) emotion inference in workplace and education, (g) biometric categorisation by sensitive attributes, (h) real-time remote biometric identification for law enforcement; points (ba) and (bb) added by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

High-risk use areas: 1 biometrics, 2 critical infrastructure safety components, 3 education, 4 employment, 5 essential services and benefits (incl. 5(b) creditworthiness, 5(c) risk assessment and pricing in insurance, 5(d) emergency call triage), 6 law enforcement, 7 migration and border control, 8 justice and democratic processes.

Transparency: providers disclose direct interaction with an AI system (1) and mark synthetic audio, image, video or text output (2); deployers inform people exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation (3) and disclose deep fakes (4).
Providers of general-purpose AI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 must comply by 2 August 2027.
Providers of systems generating synthetic content placed on the market before 2 August 2026 must comply with Art. 50(2) by 2 December 2026.
